description.value: Nightingale is a fine dining restaurant in downtown Vancouver specializing in shared plates and group dining experiences. Part of the Hawksworth Group, it offers both dine-in and takeout service with a focus on chef-curated menus. The restaurant provides a refined dining environment in the heart of the city suitable for gathering with cycling companions.
